title: Tree Level Frontier
summary: Use a FIFO frontier to process a tree in nondecreasing depth so nodes at the same distance from the root are handled together.
recognition_signals: the task asks for level order
minimum number of edges from the root matters
core_rules: Nodes leave the queue in nondecreasing depth when children are appended after their parent.
Preserve level boundaries when the output requires per-level grouping.
structural_steps: process the current front node or current level
advance to the next queued depth

common_confusions.distinction: Tree level BFS is the hierarchy-specific form of equal-cost BFS. General graph BFS additionally needs visited state because graph vertices can be reached through multiple paths or cycles.
